Hi, I'm Kimari. I center my content around navigating relationships and love, diving into emotions and mental health, and exploring my imagination through stories. This channel is a love letter to current my myself, a thank you letter to my past self, and a way for me to shape my future self.

Why don't you stay a while? Maybe you'll find something you connect with or just enjoy. Life can be lonely and confusing. But maybe we don't have to figure it out alone.
